calls.reconciliation: The runs differed on Nov 6's VIX level (23.69 / ~24.5 / 26.7). Run 1's Investing.com bar (H27.76, L23.47, last 23.69) contains all three, so they were most likely intraday prints at different times; I take the late-session level as ~23.7-24.5 and the official close as unknown. Nvidia earnings (~Nov 18-20) and CPI (~Nov 12) dates were unconfirmed by every run, so they are treated as likely, not certain, catalysts. Fade vs re-spike is pure judgment: this spike looks smaller than Aug 2024 or Apr 2025 and closer to Dec 2024, which faded fast, but the Nasdaq correction, the Kospi -9% open and hawkish Fed talk justify the right tail. I agree with the runs' reference class and dispersion (~11-14) and carry them forward. I set the median at 26.0 because Monday's high is likely ~24-25 and the max over 10 elevated-regime days typically sits a point or two above the start.
